summary.text: Jim Kofalt is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 32 who served from 2020 to 2024, returned in December 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a former technology executive and school board chair.

paragraphs.text: Jim Kofalt earned a B.S. in Russian from Georgetown University in 1987 and an M.B.A. from Syracuse University in 2008.
His career experience includes working as president of DX4 Research, a program manager with SAP, and a technical product manager with Microsoft.
He has served as school board chair of the Wilton-Lyndeborough Cooperative School District.
Kofalt served in the New Hampshire House from 2020 to 2024 and assumed his current seat on December 18, 2024.
In 2021-2022 he was assigned to the Health, Human Services and Elderly Affairs Committee, and in 2023-2024 to that committee and the Fish and Game and Marine Resources Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.
